This Week at Walt Disney World — Holiday Ride Surprises, Monstropolis Reveals & More

October 9, 2026 · Disney News & Updates

There’s a lot happening at Walt Disney World this week, and thankfully, not all of it involves spending more money! 😂

We’ve got holiday music coming to three attractions, new details about dining in Monstropolis, a beautiful new resort opening for reservations, and some fun additions to Jollywood Nights. And yes, we’ll cover those price increases, too. Grab your coffee and let’s catch up!

Three Walt Disney World Rides Are Getting Holiday Makeovers! 🎄

Three attractions are getting seasonal soundtracks, and you won’t need a separately ticketed holiday party to hear them. Two start November 4, while Guardians joins the fun later in the month.

Holiday ride dates at a glance
  • Nov. 4 – Jan. 6: Rock ’n’ Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets — Hollywood Studios
  • Nov. 4 – Jan. 6: Alien Swirling Saucers — Hollywood Studios
  • Nov. 25 – Jan. 6: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind — EPCOT
  • Separate holiday party ticket: Not required

Rock ’n’ Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets

The Electric Mayhem is getting into the holiday spirit with an Obligatory Holiday Overlay — and we love that name. 😂

Holiday songs
  • Holiday Road
  • Christmas (Baby Please Come Home)
  • Silver Bells
  • Little Saint Nick

Alien Swirling Saucers

Even the little green aliens are joining the Christmas celebration!

Alien holiday playlist
  • Toyland
  • Deck the Halls
  • Swirling, Swirling, Saucers
  • Joy to the Swirl

A fun seasonal extra for families with younger riders.

Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind

Guardians fans get a holiday soundtrack too — just on a slightly different schedule.

Cosmic Rewind holiday tracks
  • It’s the Most Wonderful Time of the Year — Andy Williams
  • Christmas Eve/Sarajevo 12/24 — Trans-Siberian Orchestra
  • Christmas Wrapping — The Waitresses

If you’re visiting earlier in November, this one won’t have started yet.

Monstropolis Is Getting Some Very Interesting Places to Eat! 👀

Disney revealed more dining concepts for the Monsters, Inc.-inspired area coming to Hollywood Studios. The details look like they could make mealtime part of the entertainment.

Harryhausen’s Restaurant

Remember the sushi restaurant from Monsters, Inc.? Disney is bringing that idea to life as a table-service restaurant.

One of the planned highlights is an eight-tentacled Audio-Animatronics sushi chef. We’re definitely curious to see that in action!

Archie’s Scare Pig Pizza and Blort

There’s also a planned quick-service pizza location and a wonderfully strange-looking beverage concept called Blort.

Still to come: Final menus, prices, and individual dining opening dates have not been announced. Monstropolis is planned for 2027.

Disney Lakeshore Lodge Is Now Taking Reservations

Disney Lakeshore Lodge is scheduled to open July 1, 2027, and reservations opened to the general public on October 8.

The 967-room resort draws inspiration from nature, with a fiber-optic river feature, bronze artwork, “Colors of the Wind”-inspired glass, and waterfront Lake Houses in the plans.

A First Look at Branch & Brush

The nature-inspired design continues in the planned Branch & Brush lounge.

Reservation dates
  • October 6: Disney Vacation Club members
  • October 7: Annual Passholders
  • October 8: General public
  • July 1, 2027: Scheduled resort opening

Reservations are now open. We’ll be watching for the practical details families care about, from transportation to dining and room layouts.

More Disney News Families Should Know

A few smaller updates are worth keeping on your radar as you plan your next visit.

Savi’s Workshop Has New Lightsaber Details

Star Wars fans have a refreshed Protection and Defense lightsaber design to discover at Savi’s Workshop, introduced October 5.

Savi’s is a paid experience, separate from park admission. The design and experience details can change, so check current options before booking.

A little family lesson learned: Our oldest son promised our grandson they’d each build a lightsaber. Neither checked the price first — $500 later! 😳😂 Definitely check the current price before making that promise!

Jollywood Nights Is Adding More Holiday Fun

Disney Jollywood Nights is bringing new additions to Hollywood Studios, including the Checkin’ It Twice Lounge, appearances by George Sanderson and Needleman, and new characters during Glisten!

Jollywood Nights dates and hours
  • November: 7, 14, 16, 21, 23, 28
  • December: 5, 7, 12, 14, 19, 21, 23
  • January 2027: 3 and 5
  • Event hours: 7:30 p.m.–12:30 a.m.
  • Early entry: 5:30 p.m.
  • Admission: Separate event ticket required

And here’s something new! Jollywood Nights is extending into January, with parties on January 3 and 5, 2027. That’s two more chances to enjoy the holiday fun after Christmas!

Scat Cat’s Club Is Temporarily Closed

If Mickey-shaped beignets are on your must-eat list, there’s a temporary change at Port Orleans Resort – French Quarter.

During the refurbishment
  • Beignets and coffee: Sassagoula Floatworks and Food Factory
  • Temporary bar: 5–11 p.m.
  • Café: Expected to reopen in December 2026
  • Lounge: Expected to reopen in January 2027

Vacation Fun Is Taking a Short Break

The Vacation Fun animated short at Hollywood Studios is scheduled to close temporarily beginning October 28.

Disney expects it to return later in 2026, but no specific reopening date has been announced. If it’s one of your favorite indoor breaks, check its status before your visit.

A Familiar Voice for Carousel of Progress

Debi Derryberry, who previously voiced Patricia, is returning as Grandmother for updated scenes in Walt Disney’s Carousel of Progress.

It’s a fun little piece of Disney history to look forward to as the attraction continues to evolve.

Walt Disney World Prices Went Up This Week 💸

Now for the news nobody really wants before planning a Disney vacation. Disney raised prices on several tickets, Annual Passes, food and drinks, and Lightning Lane Premier Pass. But the increases don’t apply equally to every date or product.

Theme Park Tickets

Disney’s ticket prices vary by park and date, and some peak dates in 2027 are getting especially expensive.

Ticket-price reminder: A one-day Magic Kingdom ticket reaches $229 on select peak 2027 dates — not every day. Comparing dates can make a real difference when buying tickets for the whole family.

Annual Pass Prices Have Increased

All four Walt Disney World Annual Pass tiers increased in price this week.

Annual PassPreviousNewIncrease
Incredi-Pass$1,629$1,749$120
Sorcerer$1,099$1,139$40
Pirate$869$909$40
Pixie Dust$489$499$10

Prices before applicable tax. Florida residency, qualifying Disney Vacation Club membership, and blockout restrictions apply to certain pass types.

Food, Drinks, and Lightning Lane

Some snacks and beverages also cost more now, and those little purchases can add up quickly on a family park day.

Other prices to watch
  • Lightning Lane Premier Pass: Up to $499 per person on select peak dates
  • Food and beverages: Some items increased in price
  • Reminder: Peak pricing is not the everyday rate

Disney Resort Discounts Could Help Families Save

After all those price increases, here’s something more encouraging! Disney has several offers for select resort stays, with additional savings for eligible Annual Passholders.

Spring 2027 Offers

Spring 2027 savings
  • General public: Up to 25% off eligible rooms
  • Eligible Annual Passholders: Up to 35% off select rooms
  • Room + ticket packages: Up to $250 per night on qualifying 4-night, 4-day packages
  • Important: Select dates, rooms, and conditions apply

Holiday 2026 Offers

Holiday 2026 savings
  • General public: Up to 20% off select rooms
  • Eligible Annual Passholders: Up to 30% off select rooms
  • Travel window: Select nights October 4–December 24, 2026
Good to know: Offers and availability can change. Always check the current savings and eligibility before booking — and ask whether a new offer can be applied to an existing reservation.

A Little More Holiday Magic Is on the Way! 🎄

Between the ride soundtracks and Jollywood Nights additions, there’s a lot to look forward to this holiday season.

And if you’re visiting sooner, EPCOT’s Food & Wine Festival is still underway while Halloween celebrations continue through October. There’s always something new to discover!
